threads.subject: Project Initialization & Milestone Scope
threads.content: Project 'File Splitter For AI Upload' initialized. Splitting engine, Win32 GUI adhering to EliteSoftware guidelines, test suite, and PowerShell build chain required across 5 milestones.

threads.subject: Milestone 1 Core Engine Handoff
threads.content: TextSplitterEngine implemented with 64KB streaming buffer, character/line limits, CR/LF preservation, UTF-8 awareness, and subfolder generation. C++ unit tests verified.

threads.subject: Milestone 2 E2E Test Suite Handoff
threads.content: Python E2E test harness created in tests/test_splitter.py covering 10,000 to 3,000 character splitting, exact boundaries, line count splitting, batch processing, and invalid parameters.

threads.subject: Milestone 3 & 4 Win32 GUI & Logger Handoff
threads.content: Implemented native Win32 GUI (Title Banner, 3D Inset WS_EX_CLIENTEDGE, Chin panel, Segoe UI, witty tooltips, About with info icon/expander, Help dialog, Settings dialog, Statusbar, Toolbar, Drag & Drop, sideloaded dynamic icon) and background thread worker with log viewer.

threads.subject: Milestone 5 Build Chain & HTML Dashboard Requirement
threads.content: Implement Scripts/01 through Scripts/05, Build.ps1, .gitignore, Git commit v1.2.0.0, README.md, and Agent-Thread_HTML live agent dashboard.

threads.subject: Milestone 5 Implementation Status
threads.content: PowerShell build scripts created, Build.ps1 verified, 64-bit and 32-bit compilation successful, HTML dashboard delivered in Agent-Thread_HTML/.
